how_we_lost: P3 Sauron won the game, but P3 and P4 killed us between them. In round 10 P3's In the Darkness Bind Them chapter IV stole Teval, Syr Konrad and Palani's Hatcher and swung them with its Wraith and Nazgûl. We blocked nothing and fell from 31 to 3. On the next turn P4's Kheru Goldkeeper hit for the last 3. Muldrotha had died in round 6, traded into Sauron on a block, and was never recast. Sol Ring was left uncast and then discarded.
winnable_why: Despite a 0-land keep, the table was slow: we were at 31-38 life through round 10, and the opponents were at 14-19 and busy fighting each other. The Coming of Galactus was one chapter from a 16/16. Three avoidable executor errors cost the game: trading Muldrotha on a pointless block at 38 life, never casting Sol Ring (the mana for her recast), and not blocking the round-10 alpha with two untapped 3/3s.

mistakes.what_happened: P3's stolen-creature alpha (Teval 4, Wraith 5, Syr Konrad 5, Palani's Hatcher 5, Nazgûl 4) came at us. Braids 3/3 and Dalek Drone 3/3 were untapped, and we blocked with neither. We went from 31 to 3, then died to P4's 3-power Kheru Goldkeeper the next turn.
mistakes.better_play: Block Palani's Hatcher (5/3) with Braids, which trades, and Teval or Syr Konrad with Drone. That saves about 10 damage and leaves us around 13.
mistakes.why: Life was the only resource that mattered that turn. The blockers were free, and taking the full swing put us in range of any follow-up.

mistakes.what_happened: We kept a 0-land 7: Cryogen Relic, Birds, Braids, Heroic Intervention, Wayfarer's Bauble, Plaguecrafter, The One Ring. The Ring was discarded to hand size at the end of turn 1.
mistakes.why: We had 1 land in round 3 and 2 in round 4, and Muldrotha did not arrive until round 6.

mistakes.what_happened: Muldrotha, cast the turn before, was blocked into Sauron 7/6 by the executor, which overruled Forge's 'no block'. We were at 38 life. Both died, and Muldrotha (now 8 mana) was never recast.
mistakes.better_play: Take the 7. Keep Muldrotha to start recasting the Ring, Bauble, Relic and Ratchet Bomb next turn.
mistakes.why: The engine was traded before she produced any value, at a life total where the damage was irrelevant. The deck never reached 8 mana again, partly because of the Sol Ring errors below.

mistakes.what_happened: Sol Ring, drawn by turn 33, was not cast on turn 33, although Sol Ring, Braids and Plaguecrafter all fit in 6 lands plus Sol's net mana. On turn 37 it was discarded at cleanup, with the executor overruling Forge's choice to discard a Swamp.
mistakes.better_play: Cast Sol Ring on turn 33. On turn 37 that gives 9 mana, enough for Muldrotha at 8, or for Animate Dead plus Syr Konrad with mana spare.
mistakes.why: Sol Ring was exactly the mana that brings Muldrotha back. Discarding it over a surplus land shows the executor misjudging card value.

mistakes.what_happened: We tapped out for Animate Dead (Drone kills Ghalta, a good play) plus Syr Konrad, while P3's In the Darkness Bind Them sat at chapter III. Chapter IV steals one creature from each opponent. Counterspell and Heroic Intervention sat in hand all game and were never cast.
mistakes.better_play: After Animate Dead, cast Sol Ring and keep Counterspell or Heroic Intervention mana up, rather than adding a 5/4 for the saga to steal.
mistakes.why: Syr Konrad became a 5-power hasty attacker against us, and his death triggers pinged us.

strategy_assessment: There was no strategist memo all game. The table was the slowest of the four games (no player below 30 until round 8), which suits a grindy Muldrotha deck: land her, keep her alive, and recur the artifacts and enchantments. The executor treated Muldrotha as a 6/6 body, blocking with her, and treated Sol Ring as a spare card. The right plan was to mulligan, protect and keep Muldrotha, use Ratchet Bomb and Coming of Galactus as the sweep and finisher, and hold Counterspell or Heroic Intervention for Living Death and Blasphemous Act, both of which the dossiers flag. Ratchet Bomb was ticked well: its sacrifice at 4 killed Monster Manual and Hulking Raptor.
summary: We lost in round 10 to P3's stolen-creature alpha plus a small P4 poke. We had kept a 0-land hand, and Muldrotha had been traded into Sauron on an unnecessary block at 38 life and never recast. The executor also left Sol Ring uncast, then discarded it, and did not block the 23-damage swing with two open 3/3s. The table was slow enough that clean play likely at least survives to Galactus.
